title: Runbook
description: An ordered checklist in which every step carries its own verify. Answers 'what is the correct way to do this' before starting. 2.0 (ADR-0019): a runbook is identified by its `uid` (a UUIDv7 created with it) and names its `type`; the numbered `id` (and the LL-NEW placeholder a hook used to allocate) is gone, and the number it is shown with is computed from its place among its siblings (`order`, then creation). 2.1 (additive): `lessons` names lessons by uid, as every record link does (ADR-0019); a 2.0 document's numbered `LL-NNN` codes still validate, so 2.0 stays readable, but a record holding one is refused by the record validation (homelabnext.registers.schema) and is migrated by `hnx records assign-uids`.

uid.description: A canonical UUIDv7: the record's identity, never changed.

order.description: Optional sort key among its siblings.

when.description: Trigger: when to open this runbook.

anyOf.description: 2.0: a numbered lesson code, before uids; readable, never written (a record holding one is refused).

lessons.description: 2.1: the lessons the runbook was written from, by uid (ADR-0019).

uid.description: A record uid: a canonical UUIDv7 (lowercase, version 7), created with the record and never changed (ADR-0019).
